free_tier.stated: New keys start with 0.1 credits, subject to availability; one credit is one US dollar. A key is minted by one unauthenticated POST /api/v1/keys with no signup form, no email verification and no card.
free_tier.notes: The landing page says 'No credit card. New keys start with a small free credit grant.' The skill.md state of 2026-11-21 names the exact grant: 0.1 credits, subject to availability. At the shared rate of $0.0107 per hour this is about 9 hours of always-on shared-container time; derived: 0.1 credits / $0.0107 per hour = 9.35 hours.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a running container, not a stored object; persistent volumes are 1, 5 or 20 GB and are not billed

retention.stated: A persistent volume survives restarts, redeploys, sleep and running out of credits, and only goes away when the project is deleted; no automatic data expiry is stated.

egress.terms: No egress price or allowance is published on the pricing page, instances page or skill: the platform reverse-proxies the app and sets X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto; custom domains cost $0.01 per active domain per day.

interface_detail: REST API under https://cloudish.ai/api/v1 for keys, projects, images, domains, secrets and logs, a generated Anthropic-style skill.md for coding agents, and an optional dashboard; ChatGPT and Cursor use plugins.
tooling: curl against the REST API or the skill.md installed into Claude/Codex/Cursor; server-side BuildKit builds from a tar.gz Dockerfile context or an existing image reference, so no local Docker daemon or registry is needed.
chaining: An agent mints its own key, deploys a Dockerfile or image to a permanent https subdomain, attaches a 1/5/20 GB volume and can mint child keys with capped budgets, so a parent agent can fund sub-agents that each deploy and pay from their own balance.

limits.value: Prepaid balance: shared $0.0107/hour or $7.84/month always on, small $0.0297/hour, medium $0.0533/hour, large $0.1007/hour, gpu $2.73/hour; a key cannot go below zero
At zero balance new builds and deploys answer 402, running containers stop within a minute and volumes are kept; a rolling 24-hour usage quota can also return 429 code limit_exceeded

limits_note: shared is billed for 0.1 CPU and 0.2 GB but may use up to 1 CPU and 1 GB when spare; it is restarted first under memory pressure. Sleeping defaults to 15 minutes without requests. Apps that keep receiving requests keep billing. At most 10 custom domains can be added per hour and 20 can be pending at once. An RTX 4060 GPU is exclusive: a second GPU app gets 409 gpu_busy until the first sleeps.
binding_note: The prepaid key balance caps every call and a zero balance stops builds and containers within a minute, so the remaining credit is what binds before any published rate limit.

identity_cost.detail: One unauthenticated POST https://cloudish.ai/api/v1/keys returns a key and a claim URL; no browser, OAuth, signup form, email verification, card or approval step is required for the initial key. A 0.1-credit grant is included subject to availability. Claiming is optional and attaches the key to a human account through an Auth0-backed OpenID Connect sign-in for a dashboard and more credits.

reliability_note: shared containers are restarted first when a machine runs short of memory; running apps stop within a minute when a key reaches zero, and volumes are kept. Network traffic between pods in the cluster is not restricted on this deployment; the platform adds no CORS or security headers beyond Strict-Transport-Security.
confidence_note: Rates, the free grant and the anonymous key gate are quoted from Cloudish's own homepage, instances.md and skill.md read 2026-11-24; the credit stop and container isolation are quoted from credits.md and container.md the same day. No key was minted and no container was deployed, so no measured claim is made.

Egress is not separately priced on the pages read; that is a gap rather than a claim of free unlimited traffic.
